data.long_meaning: In Greek, Alviani is derived from the name Alvis, which means 'elf' or 'wanderer'. The suffix -ian denotes a friend or companion. Thus, Alviani can be translated as 'friend of Elvis'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the elven sage Alvian, who provided spiritual guidance to St. Columba. The name Alviani carries the meaning “Friend of Elvis” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alviani usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of elvis and live with faith, good character and purpose.
